text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. 
Out of curiosity, do you like tsukudani?
choice_data_list: I do, but why do you ask?
I do, but what made you ask?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well, yesterday when I went out, I came 
across a 
Hokkaido fair. And there, I found some 
truly magnificent 
kelp from Hidaka on sale...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It reminded me so much of home... 
I ended up buying quite a lot without 
thinking, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I made a bit too much. 
Of the kelp tsukudani, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how careless of me. 
If you'd like, would you care to have 
some?
